description: This file manages the DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) configuration in a network device's web interface. It includes PHP code to retrieve current settings, and JavaScript for client-side validation and UI interactions related to enabling/disabling DMZ, and configuring IPv4 and IPv6 host addresses.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string and returns an array of its segments, handling '::' abbreviations.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks whether the input fields with a given prefix are empty, considering IPv6 prefix conditions.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates values from input fields with a given prefix, using a separator.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address inputs are required based on input fields.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv4 address inputs are required.

methods.name: saveQoS
methods.description: Saves DMZ configuration via AJAX POST request to the server script.

methods.name: populate_IPv6
methods.description: Populates IPv6 address fields with the prefix and address segments, disabling fields as needed.
